purpose: Durable pixel-read trade-dress authority and cover-generation gate for Azure Reach issue covers.

authority.issueSpecificRecipe: The assembled Azure Reach cover recipe controls the selling image, issue-specific concept, cast, composition, spoiler ceiling, thumbnail read and exact scripted cover copy.
authority.releasedTradeDress: The released Azure Reach Issue 1 cover in StarSplitterVisions controls established masthead geometry, Star Splitter Visions publisher-mark placement, issue-number block, cyan/white/navy lettering hierarchy and premium cover-brand finish.
authority.releasedStoryCanon: Released Azure Reach Issue 1 story pages continue to control established visual identity and world appearance for characters/locations depicted in later covers.
authority.scopeRule: Apply authorities by scope. The Issue 1 cover is a trade-dress reference, not a composition template and never an interior-page layout reference.

coverRecipeSource.rule: Use the exact assembled cover recipe. Raw metadata not emitted by the assembler is not generation instruction.

sessionStartGate: Resolve the requested Azure Reach cover show and assemble its exact RexPrompt recipe.
Retrieve and visually inspect the actual pixels of the released Issue 1 cover from the canonical StarSplitterVisions path above.
Use the Issue 1 pixels only for masthead/trade-dress continuity.
Resolve any recurring character/location appearance from released StarSplitterVisions canon and clearly approved current-production artwork.
Build a small reference set: Issue 1 cover for trade dress plus the strongest relevant character/world references for the issue-specific illustration.
Do not generate until the actual cover pixels and required visual references are present in active multimodal context.
perCoverGate: Confirm one dominant commercial hook and one primary focal hierarchy from the assembled recipe.
Confirm the upper masthead/issue-number negative-space zone is preserved.
Confirm the image remains legible at thumbnail scale.
Confirm no later-issue payoff or spoiler-ceiling exclusion has been visualized.
Confirm animals remain safe, natural and never treated as the joke.
Confirm no unscripted cover copy, environmental text, fake social text or promotional labels were added.
After generation, compare masthead/trade dress directly against the Issue 1 pixel reference and compare characters/world against proper visual authorities.
outputRule: A normal Azure Reach cover is one finished full-color portrait comic cover with exactly the scripted trade-dress copy, one issue-specific selling image, clean thumbnail hierarchy and no interior panel grid. Do not add character handles, dossier framing, recap collage, extra blurbs, environmental text or unscripted promotional copy.
